_comment: Content model for §04 — three stages: Conviction, Clarity, Commitment. Condensed from brochure (philosophy/edge) in VEM voice.
heading: Conviction. Clarity.
Commitment.
lead: Three principles guide every decision we make — and every portfolio we build.

feature.alt: A quiet private study at golden hour — books, a globe, warm light

stages.title: Conviction
stages.body: We own companies while their earnings and revenues exceed the market's expectations — capitalizing on the inefficiencies of traditional Wall Street forecasting, and holding that conviction through a full market cycle.

stages.title: Clarity
stages.body: Every position is the output of a disciplined, repeatable process: proprietary quantitative screens, fundamental validation, and visible risk controls. No black boxes, no story stocks.

stages.title: Commitment
stages.body: We are fiduciaries firm-wide, with the personal accountability of a boutique. We measure ourselves by the trust you place in us — protected and grown, quarter after quarter.
